title: M5: a boat at 4 m/s across a 100 m river flowing at 3 m/s, then to the point opposite
about: straight across: t = 100/4 = 25 s, drift 3·25 = 75 m, v = 5 m/s; opposite: sin α = 3/4 (48.6°), v = √7, t = 100/√7 = 37.8 s

lines.say: Imagine a boat crossing a river 100 metres wide.
The boat moves at 4 metres per second in still water.
The river flows at 3 metres per second.
Now the boat wants to reach the point directly opposite.
